title: Pretrees
description: Sets with a betweenness relation that behaves as in a tree: the axioms, intervals, the theorem that every finite pretree is a set of vertices of a finite tree, directions on linear sets, uniqueness of medians, and dense, complete and median pretrees, with an example of a complete dense pretree that is not median, separable pretrees, whose intervals are ordered like the real interval [0,1], and a theorem that recognizes dendrites by a pretree structure.

units.title: Separable pretrees and the order of intervals

prerequisites: graphs, paths, cycles and connected graphs (definitions only)
for the fourth lesson: the course Continua, arcs and cut points (arcs, dendrites) and the Urysohn metrization theorem (core course Point-Set Topology)
the course proves every other fact it uses
